ContentDesc_Schiffbrecher-Insel:
To the chagrin of countless treasure hunters, the golden coffer of the legendary Mistbeard was not to be found on Hullbreaker Isle. And so like the mists which had withdrawn to reveal the isle did those ambitious souls depart to seek fame and fortune elsewhere, allowing Eynzahr Slafyrsyn to quietly petition Admiral Merlwyb for permission to repurpose it as a training ground for Maelstrom recruits.

The storm marshal would have you be the first to brave this gauntlet, that you might pit yourself against the isle's fearsome fauna and the Maelstrom's elite, and in so doing rouse their spirits. Will you give the storm officers a beating they will not soon forget, or will they stand triumphant at the last and shout that they have bested the Warrior of Light?
Instancecontenttextdata_12307_Text: They never knew what hit 'em... Not that I'm surprised. If a handful o' raptors had given you any trouble, the gods only know what they'd have done to the rest of us!
Instancecontenttextdata_12309_Text: Pick up the pace, soldier! These ain't even the small fry!
Instancecontenttextdata_12312_Text: Now yer all nice an' limbered up, we'll let ye loose on some more civilized targets!
Instancecontenttextdata_12317_Text: Forgive me, Brother. I couldn't keep up...
Instancecontenttextdata_12318_Text: Knights o' the Barracuda, to your positions!
Instancecontenttextdata_12319_Text: No doubt you've heard tales of our skill at arms, adventurer. And now you shall witness it firsthand.
Instancecontenttextdata_12320_Text: Seven hells... To think I spoke of our skill at arms...
Instancecontenttextdata_12323_Text: <pant> <pant> I yield! I yield!By the Navigator... <pant> <pant>That was...inspirational!
Instancecontenttextdata_12326_Text: Tsk-tsk. Didn't nobody ever tell ye the 'ells 'ave no fury like a Siren scorned? Yer gizzard won't be fit fer the chum bucket when we're through with ye!
Instancecontenttextdata_12327_Text: Sound the bell o' the Lady Infernal! Make ready the cannons!
Instancecontenttextdata_12332_Text: Like that, is it? PAH! All guns! Bombard the bilge-swillin' scrags!
Instancecontenttextdata_12333_Text: Now that's a 'venturer after me own 'eart!That lust for blood... Oooh, it sets me skin atingle.
Instancecontenttextdata_12334_Text: Bested the Sirens already? Why, Rhoswen would scarce have had time to swear herself hoarse.
Instancecontenttextdata_12336_Text: No matter. I am come to test the worth of the Krakens' newest acquisition. I trust you will oblige me...?
Instancecontenttextdata_12338_Text: You seem to be keeping up with her quite well─thus far, at least. Did I mention that Ymir has hidden talents?
Instancecontenttextdata_12339_Text: Hmph. 'Twould seem I wasted my coin. Very well. Victory is yours. Be on your way.
Instancecontenttextdata_12342_Text: You seem to be treading water, Marshal. If I did not know better, I should think you cared naught for our company's good name.
Instancecontenttextdata_12343_Text: Spare me, Admiral. I hold my duty to the Maelstrom above all else─as you well know. Nevertheless, I will not deny that this uniform now prevents me from doing my worst.
Instancecontenttextdata_12344_Text: But since all here present are privy to the truth, might we not loosen the collar and hearken back to the glory days, just this once? ...By your leave, o' course.
Instancecontenttextdata_12345_Text: As you like. 'Twill make for a better spectacle.
Instancecontenttextdata_12346_Text: Heh. I said I'd never don you again, old friend. But many a man would trade the wisdom of years for a minute of youthful hubris...
Instancecontenttextdata_12350_Text: Nothin' gets the blood pumpin' like scrappin' with a pack o' ravenous beasties!
